status: instrument freeze (PD-22 binding 7): pins the scorer and the job; changes nothing registered

scorer_modes.gate: pins every gate_pins file of frozen_files, checks this addendum, then reproduces the S1 gate from S1's dev outputs (per-image CIDEr-D, D_MBR, dCHAIR_i, MBR picks and bytes); reads no test output
scorer_modes.dryrun: synthetic references, decodes and provenance: stamp, admission with refusals, selection, evaluate.py and F0 end to end, K-F0, a failing self-check row, every verdict branch
scorer_modes.run: refuses unless this scorer and its all-PASS gate record are committed at HEAD and B_F1_STAGE is unset; re-runs the gate body and requires it equal to the record; admits the decodes; selects; scores each system once with evaluate.py; F0; then the statistics
scorer_modes.check: the job's pre-decode check on the decode host (records its machine_id and card); writes the caption-free view of test_data.json
scorer_modes.stamp: the job's per-decode .sha256 sidecar and provenance JSON

cost.basis: S1 cost.dev_decode_gpu_h_each per dev300 decode, scaled to the test size, three decodes
cost.machine: one host decodes all three members in one job; the host has exactly one GPU with >= 24 GB; check records its machine_id and card, and all three provenances must carry that same machine_id and card; every other pin stays exact

queue_preconditions: the decode host's HEAD is the commit that adds this addendum, the scorer, the job and the gate and dry-run records
G-1 has passed for that HEAD (the job runs check_g1_pass.py)
the adapters p1dev_s42, p1dev_s43 and p1dev_s44 are under $NCS_DATA/runs with their registered sha256
the queue file is a byte-identical copy of the committed job (it greps its own sha256 here)
